item.title: FBI is buying location data to track US citizens, director confirms
item.description:
📝 This is the first time since 2023 that the FBI has confirmed it was buying access to people’s data collected from data brokers, who source much of their information — including location data — from ordinary consumer phone apps and games, per Politico. Wyden: Can you commit to not buying Americans' location data. agencies have skirted this legal step by purchasing commercially available data from companies that amass large amounts of people’s location data originally derived from phone apps or other commercial tracking technology.
🔗 Read more: https://techcrunch.com/2026/03/18/fbi-is-buying-location-data-to-track-us-citizens-kash-patel-wyden/

item.title: I haven't used a mouse for 14 years
item.description:
📝 I haven't used a mouse for 14 years, and how to enable three fingers drag on macOS 13 Mar, 2026 I have been using a Mac since 2012, and since then I have not used an external mouse (I did buy an external trackpad, and also own an iMac with trackpad included). Most design work requires dragging cursor to move objects, dragging requires clicking the trackpad and putting force on finger repeatedly, and this can feel uncomfortable after extended period. Luckily there's a "Three fingers drag" option where you can place three fingers on the trackpad, then move them at the same time, to perform drag.
🔗 Read more: https://axelk.ee/i-havent-used-a-mouse-for-14-years-and-how-to-enable-three-fingers-drag-on-macos/
